msg: Hi, I'm Advanced Open Water certified, from London. I'm staying at a hotel on Isla Grande for 5 days. I'd like the 4-dive package over 2 days. How much and how do I book?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Since you’re staying on Isla Grande, this is the “already on the islands” option; accommodation is booked directly with your hotel and isn’t included.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• Fun Dives - 1 dive (1 day): 97 USD · 108 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD

You can book here: https://divingplanet.org/buceo-islas-del-rosario/ — choose your date and number of people in the booking calendar.

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you like help with anything else about the package?

msg: Great, I'll take the 4-dive package for next Tuesday and Wednesday. I'm at Hotel Isla del Encanto. Do I need to bring my certification card? How do I pay?
reply:
Yes, please bring your diving certification card. You can also send a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day. Please be ready at your hotel at 9:30 a.m.

As an international guest, you pay 100% by card through the online booking link. The 10% online discount is applied automatically. Your payment is recorded right away, and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking. If the online payment fails, the team can send a bank-transfer payment link while keeping the online discount.

Book here: https://divingplanet.org/buceo-islas-del-rosario/

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊

msg: Just me, 1 person. Is that link really where I book the package? I only see general info there.
reply:
Yes, that link is the correct page for the 4-dive package for certified divers already on the islands. It shows general information first; bookings are made through the activity link, and the 10% online discount is applied automatically. You book and pay on the website by card. The payment is recorded right away, and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking.

Has it been *more than 2 years* since your last dive?
